clue.text: Magistrate at party good in cutthroat competition

parts.note: the Doge was the chief magistrate of Venice and Genoa

clue.text: Like project that never gets off the ground?

a person or thing of outstanding quality

clue.text: Quick wit?

clue.text: Fish and rook in quarrel
